adopt_metadata_object.description: Add a base-configuration object or member to an extension for customization. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('adopt_metadata_object').

apply_quick_fix.description: Apply an EDT quick fix to a validation problem. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('apply_quick_fix').

build_external_objects.description: Compile external 1C data processors and reports into deployable files. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('build_external_objects').

clean_project.description: Rebuild an EDT project from the on-disk src/ files and revalidate everything. Direction DISK -> MODEL; slow, and it DISCARDS unsaved in-memory model edits - save first. For one externally-edited object prefer revalidate_objects; for the opposite direction see resync_to_disk. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('clean_project').

create_git_branch.description: Start isolated work on a new Git branch for an EDT project. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('create_git_branch').

create_infobase.description: Prepare an infobase for an EDT project by creating a database or registering an existing one. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('create_infobase').

params.infobaseFile: Absolute path to the infobase directory. FILE infobases only - server/web are rejected.

create_launch_config.description: Configure an EDT runtime client for launching a 1C application. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('create_launch_config').

create_metadata.description: Add a new metadata object or member to a configuration. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('create_metadata').

create_project.description: Start a new EDT configuration, extension, or external-objects project. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('create_project').

debug_launch.description: Run a 1C application under EDT debugging. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('debug_launch').

debug_status.description: Check which EDT debug sessions are running or paused. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('debug_status').

debug_yaxunit_tests.description: DEPRECATED alias of run_yaxunit_tests(debug=true) - prefer that instead; behaviour is identical. Kept for compatibility. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('debug_yaxunit_tests').

delete_infobase.description: Remove a project's infobase or its standalone-server registration, optionally deleting the database files. DESTRUCTIVE and IRREVERSIBLE. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to preview, then again with confirm=true to apply. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('delete_infobase').

delete_launch_config.description: Remove an unused EDT runtime or attach launch configuration. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to preview, then again with confirm=true to apply. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('delete_launch_config').

delete_metadata.description: Delete a metadata object or member (FQN-addressed). DESTRUCTIVE and CASCADING - removing an object also removes what references it. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to preview what will be removed, then again with confirm=true to apply. A delete that would break references is blocked; force overrides that block and can leave dangling references behind. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('delete_metadata').

delete_project.description: Remove an EDT project from the workspace, optionally with its sources on disk. DESTRUCTIVE and IRREVERSIBLE. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to preview, then again with confirm=true to apply. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('delete_project').

enable_toolset.description: Make additional MCP tool groups visible or hide them. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('enable_toolset').

evaluate_expression.description: Evaluate a BSL expression in a paused debug frame and return the value. WARNING: this executes arbitrary code in the running application - it can change state, not just read it. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('evaluate_expression').

export_common_picture.description: Inspect or extract the image data of a 1C common picture. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('export_common_picture').

export_configuration_to_xml.description: Export an EDT configuration into 1C XML files. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('export_configuration_to_xml').

find_references.description: Discover where a metadata object is used throughout the configuration and BSL code. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('find_references').

generate_translation_strings.description: Collect translatable strings of a configuration for a translation provider. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('generate_translation_strings').

get_applications.description: Discover infobases connected to an EDT project. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_applications').

get_check_description.description: Understand an EDT validation rule and how to fix its diagnostic. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_check_description').

get_configuration_properties.description: Inspect the identity and compatibility settings of a 1C configuration. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_configuration_properties').

get_content_assist.description: Find valid BSL completion suggestions at a source-code position. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_content_assist').

get_edt_version.description: Identify the installed 1C:EDT version. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_edt_version').

get_event_log.description: Investigate infobase activity and errors through its event log. Returns PII and live infobase data - user names, session data and business-record references. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_event_log').

get_form_layout_snapshot.description: Inspect the calculated visual layout of an EDT form. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_form_layout_snapshot').

get_form_screenshot.description: Visually inspect an EDT form as rendered by the designer. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_form_screenshot').

get_markers.description: Find bookmarks and TODO-style task markers in the workspace. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_markers').

params.markerKind: 'bookmark' = manual navigation bookmarks; 'task' = TODO/FIXME/XXX/HACK code markers. Omit for both.

get_mcp_history.description: Diagnose MCP tool calls by reviewing recent requests, failures, timings, and context usage. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_mcp_history').

get_metadata_details.description: Inspect the properties and structure of a metadata object or member. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_metadata_details').

get_metadata_objects.description: Discover metadata objects available in a 1C configuration. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_metadata_objects').

get_method_call_hierarchy.description: Trace which BSL methods call a method or are called by it. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_method_call_hierarchy').

params.direction: 'callers' = who calls this method, 'callees' = what it calls.

get_module_structure.description: Discover procedures, functions, regions, and execution contexts in a BSL module. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_module_structure').

get_objects_by_tags.description: Find metadata objects organized under selected tags. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_objects_by_tags').

get_outgoing_structures.description: Discover the fields passed to outgoing or qualified BSL method calls. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_outgoing_structures').

get_platform_documentation.description: Find the exact API of a built-in 1C type or global function. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_platform_documentation').

get_problem_summary.description: See validation problem counts grouped by project and severity. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_problem_summary').

get_profiling_results.description: Identify performance hotspots in executed BSL code. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_profiling_results').

get_project_errors.description: Find detailed validation errors and warnings in an EDT project. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_project_errors').

params.objectFqns: EXACT model addresses; mutually exclusive with objects. Returns objectsNotFound / objectsUnsupported.
params.objects: Loose case-insensitive SUBSTRING match against the reported location; mutually exclusive with objectFqns.

get_server_status.description: Diagnose the EDT MCP server and its feature configuration. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_server_status').

get_subsystem_content.description: Inspect which metadata objects and child subsystems belong to a 1C subsystem. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_subsystem_content').

get_symbol_info.description: Inspect the type and documentation of a BSL symbol at its source location. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_symbol_info').

get_tags.description: Discover user-defined tags used to organize project metadata. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_tags').

get_template_screenshot.description: Visually inspect how a spreadsheet print template renders. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_template_screenshot').

get_tool_guide.description: Retrieve detailed instructions for an MCP tool. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_tool_guide').

get_translation_project_info.description: Inspect the translation setup of an EDT project. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_translation_project_info').

get_variables.description: Inspect runtime variables in a paused debug frame. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_variables').

go_to_definition.description: Locate the source definition of a BSL symbol or metadata object. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('go_to_definition').

import_configuration_from_xml.description: Create an EDT project from exported 1C configuration XML files. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('import_configuration_from_xml').

list_breakpoints.description: Review breakpoints currently set in BSL source code. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('list_breakpoints').

list_common_pictures.description: Inventory common pictures available in a 1C configuration. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('list_common_pictures').

list_configurations.description: Discover EDT runtime and server-side launch configurations. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('list_configurations').

list_git_branches.description: Inspect available Git branches and their EDT infobase bindings. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('list_git_branches').

list_modules.description: Discover BSL modules available in an EDT project. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('list_modules').

list_projects.description: Discover projects available in the EDT workspace. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('list_projects').

list_subsystems.description: Discover the subsystem hierarchy of a 1C configuration. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('list_subsystems').

list_toolsets.description: Discover available groups of MCP tools and their visibility. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('list_toolsets').

modify_metadata.description: Set properties of any metadata node (object or member, including form items, attributes, commands, and handlers).

read_method_source.description: Inspect the source of one BSL procedure or function. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('read_method_source').

read_module_source.description: Inspect the source of a complete BSL module. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('read_module_source').

remove_breakpoint.description: Stop pausing execution at a BSL source breakpoint. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('remove_breakpoint').

rename_metadata_object.description: Rename a metadata object or member and rewrite every reference to it. CASCADES ACROSS THE WHOLE CONFIGURATION - BSL, forms, roles, subsystems. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to see the edit scope, then again with confirm=true to apply. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('rename_metadata_object').

resume.description: Continue a paused 1C debug session. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('resume').

resync_to_disk.description: Write the in-memory model back out to the on-disk src/ .mdo files and report model-to-disk desync; fixes 'object file does not exist' failures and dangling Configuration.mdo references. Direction MODEL -> DISK, the opposite of clean_project. Read-safe by default: dangling references are REPORTED by default, not removed. Two opt-in modes are DESTRUCTIVE: re-exporting every object overwrites on-disk edits, and removing dangling references rewrites Configuration.mdo. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('resync_to_disk').

revalidate_objects.description: Revalidate a project or a named list of objects, picking up .mdo edits made outside EDT. Targeted, lightweight alternative to clean_project - no full rebuild, nothing discarded. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('revalidate_objects').

run_yaxunit_tests.description: Run YAXUnit tests for a 1C configuration. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('run_yaxunit_tests').

params.debug: true launches in DEBUG mode so breakpoints fire and returns a launch handle immediately - call wait_for_break next. Default false polls and returns the report.

search_in_code.description: Literal/regex full-text search across BSL modules. Matching is textual and NOT ru/en dialect-aware, so a query in one BSL language will not find the other spelling - for a symbol's usages use find_references, for where it is defined use go_to_definition. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('search_in_code').

set_branch_infobase.description: Associate an existing infobase with a Git branch of an EDT project. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('set_branch_infobase').

set_breakpoint.description: Pause BSL execution at a selected source line during debugging. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('set_breakpoint').

set_infobase_credentials.description: Enable EDT to connect to a protected infobase for updates or debugging. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('set_infobase_credentials').

set_variable.description: Change a variable while execution is paused in the debugger. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('set_variable').

start_profiling.description: Measure execution time and coverage of BSL code in a debug session. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('start_profiling').

step.description: Advance paused debug execution one step. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('step').

stop_profiling.description: Finish measuring BSL performance in a debug session. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('stop_profiling').

switch_git_branch.description: Change the active version of an EDT project through Git branch checkout. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('switch_git_branch').

terminate_launch.description: Stop 1C sessions started by EDT. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to see what would be stopped, then again with confirm=true to apply. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('terminate_launch').

translate_configuration.description: Translate a 1C configuration into target languages. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('translate_configuration').

update_database.description: Apply the current EDT configuration to an infobase. DESTRUCTIVE - restructures data and can evict live sessions. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to preview, then again with confirm=true to apply. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('update_database').

validate_query.description: Check a 1C query for syntax and metadata-reference errors. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('validate_query').

validate_xdto_package.description: Check an XDTO package for configuration validation problems. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('validate_xdto_package').

wait_for_break.description: Wait until a running 1C debug session reaches a breakpoint or other suspend event. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('wait_for_break').

write_module_source.description: Create or edit BSL source in a metadata module. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('write_module_source').

params.expectedHash: Lost-update guard: the hash from the read that produced your edit. The write is rejected if the module changed since.
